facts.fact: Minister Paula Ingabire told the Chamber of Deputies that the Irembo platform offers 240 government services, including civil registration, driving permits and business licences, which citizens can apply for online.
MINICT says citizens submitted over 5 million applications through Irembo between 2023 and 2024, and more than 400,000 Rwandans had opened personal accounts as of March 2025.
